FROM operation_scores;

            WHEN opsstatus = 'Completed' AND (resourceallocstate = 'Limited' OR supplyflowstate = 'Strained') THEN 25
            WHEN opsstatus = 'Completed' AND supplyflowstate = 'Stable' THEN 50
            WHEN opsstatus = 'Scaling Down' AND (resourceallocstate = 'Critical' OR supplyflowstate = 'Disrupted') THEN 75
            ELSE 100
        END AS score
    FROM operations
)
SELECT 
    opsregistry,
    CASE 
        WHEN score >= 80 THEN 'Completed'
        WHEN score BETWEEN 50 AND 80 THEN 'Scaling Down'
        ELSE 'Active'
    END AS new_status
FROM operation_scores;
